entries.label: Sentences
entries.en: The beach was long and narrow and sloped gently down to the sea.
entries.zh: 海滩很长很窄 很温和地向海边倾斜

entries.label: Sentences
entries.en: He was surrounded by sugar white beaches and a vivid blue sea that stretched for miles.
entries.zh: 他被白糖沙滩和一片绵延数英里的生动蓝海包围.

entries.label: Sentences
entries.en: The emerald jewel of coral reefs and diamond dust beaches was enclosed by a lush green forest.
entries.zh: 珊瑚礁和钻石沙滩的翡翠宝石被一片茂密的绿林包围。

entries.label: Sentences
entries.en: The beach was a long arc of golden sand, sheltered by dunes and large umbrella palm trees.
entries.zh: 海滩是金色沙子的长弧形,以沙丘和大型雨伞棕榈树为栖息地.

entries.label: Sentences
entries.en: The small, sheltered cove was reached by scrambling down a steep, winding path.
entries.zh: 穿过一条陡峭的风流道路,到达了小的,被庇护的海湾.

entries.label: Phrases – Verbs

entries.label: Phrases – Verbs
entries.en: Echo of pain and death lingered

entries.label: Sentences
entries.en: It was an eerie, lifeless island guarded by steep, rocky cliffs.
entries.zh: 它是一个充满活力的无生命的岛屿 由陡峭的岩石峭壁守卫

entries.label: Sentences
entries.en: The rocky island slopes were ablaze with purple heather.
entries.zh: 岩石般的岛坡被紫色热器点燃.

entries.label: Sentences
entries.en: They had arrived in a paradise of tropical islands, with swaying palm trees, pure white beaches and brilliant turquoise lagoons.
entries.zh: 他们来到了热带岛屿的天堂 棕榈树摇摇欲坠 纯白的海滩和辉煌的绿洲

entries.label: Sentences
entries.en: The island was circled by a shallow lagoon on a beautiful reef teeming with multi-coloured corals and tropical fish.
entries.zh: 该岛由一个浅水的环礁湖环绕,礁上分布着多色珊瑚和热带鱼类。

entries.label: Sentences
entries.en: The island was a time capsule. Wherever they went they found relics of an ancient world.
entries.zh: 岛上是一个时间胶囊,无论他们去哪里,都发现了古老世界的遗迹。

entries.label: Sentences
entries.en: Littered with bones, the shore was a jigsaw of human and animal skeletons.
entries.zh: 岸边是人类和动物骨架的拼图

entries.zh: 火焰喷泉像一阵血流成河

entries.label: Phrases – Nouns and Adjectives
entries.en: Towering, black clouds of ash and smoke

entries.label: Phrases – Nouns and Adjectives
entries.en: Cauldron of spitting bubbles, hissing steam and belching fumes

entries.label: Phrases – Verbs
entries.en: Crater loomed ominously over the town

entries.label: Phrases – Verbs
entries.zh: 紧随其后的是震撼的巨浪

entries.label: Sentences
entries.en: The air was thick with choking fumes.
entries.zh: 空气充满了窒息的烟雾。

entries.label: Sentences
entries.en: The earth trembled and shook and sent everything crashing to the ground.
entries.zh: 地球颤抖 震动 将一切坠落到地上

entries.label: Sentences
entries.en: It was hard to breathe and hard to see in the smoky, black haze.
entries.zh: 在烟雾黑雾中很难呼吸 也很难看见

entries.label: Sentences
entries.en: Huge black clouds blocked out the sun, and darkness fell.
entries.zh: 巨大的黑云挡住了太阳 黑暗降临了

entries.label: Sentences
entries.en: Torrents of sizzling, smouldering ash and rocks rained from the sky.
entries.zh: 滚烫的灰烬和岩石如暴雨般从天而降。

entries.label: Sentences
entries.en: As the volcano erupted, there was a deafening boom and the ground trembled and shook.
entries.zh: 随着火山的爆发,震动的隆起,地面震动和震动。

entries.label: Sentences
entries.en: A fountain of fire, like a throbbing wound, flooded the sky.
entries.zh: 火焰喷泉,像一阵阵痛的伤口,淹没了天空.

entries.label: Sentences
entries.en: Looming ominously over the village, the crater and its plume of vapour was a silent, menacing reminder of its awesome power.
entries.zh: 陨石坑及其蒸气流在村里飘荡,令人惊恐,使人想起它的威力。

entries.zh: 伸展到眼睛所看到的地方

entries.zh: 风把沙子扔进他们的喉咙和眼睛

entries.label: Phrases – Verbs

entries.label: Sentences
entries.en: The desert was a furnace. It was a land of burning sands.
entries.zh: 沙漠是一座熔炉,是一片烧沙之地.

entries.label: Sentences
entries.en: Huge sand dunes had been blown away by the sand storm and dumped elsewhere.
entries.zh: 巨大的沙丘被沙暴吹走 并被丢弃到别处

entries.label: Sentences
entries.en: The endless, flat horizon was suddenly broken by a group of tall rock pillars like giant mushrooms.
entries.zh: 无限平坦的地平线突然被一群像巨型蘑菇一样高耸的岩石柱断裂.

entries.label: Sentences
entries.en: The desert spread out before him – a sea of sand, shimmering with heat.
entries.zh: 在他之前,沙漠已散布——一片沙海,充满热浪。

entries.label: Sentences
entries.en: It was a burning, merciless desert of glare and death.
entries.zh: 是一个燃烧的无情的沙漠 光芒和死亡。
